title: Support configuration option --with-jni-libpath?
snippet:
Summary of problem
------------------

OpenJDK introduced the configuration option `--with-jni-libpath` in Java 12, which affects the definition of `HOTSPOT_OVERRIDE_LIBPATH`, ultimately altering the default value of `java.library.path`. As the name suggests, this is specific to HotSpot, but https://github.com/ibmruntimes/openj9-openjdk-jdk21/issues/386 wonders if OpenJ9 might support that option.

##  Restricted Transactional Memory (RTM)
